attacksRun.attack: EV-2 and EV-3 are collapsed (my own attack)
attacksRun.evidence: The sharpest structural trap in this specification, stated twice in live bytes: the NT-5 class intent says 'EV-2 and EV-3 are not collapsed.' and EV-3 says 'This member is not collapsed into EV-2.' The subject honours it. It gives EV-3 its own dedicated state (unknown-to-covered, sourced 'G23 v1 NT-5 / EV-3 exactByteIntent') and gives EV-2 two states (narrows, widens, both sourced EV-2), with disjoint state sets. That split is faithful rather than inventive: live EV-2 genuinely holds two records, one 'that narrows the host-requested domain' and one 'that widens it'. Splitting a two-record member into two named states is finer-grained than the live grouping but adds no content.

decision.summaryForCoordinator: ACCEPT. 21 attacks run, 19 refuted, 2 not sustained as a finding. 0 blockers, 0 MUST-FIX, 0 SHOULD-FIX. All 4 named states trace verbatim to live G23 v1 exactByteIntent, which I located structurally first — it sits across namedCorpusClasses[NT-3, NT-5] and retainedEvidence[EV-1, EV-2, EV-3], six occurrences in two containers. The decisive structural trap is honoured: live states twice that EV-2 and EV-3 are not collapsed, and the subject gives EV-3 its own state while giving EV-2 two, a split that is faithful because live EV-2 genuinely holds both a narrows record and a widens record. Live namedCorpusClasses and namedClassesThisGate are exactly [NT-3, NT-5]; NT-1/NT-2/NT-4/NT-6/NT-7/NT-8 each occur only inside negations and none is used as a class, id, or state. D-147's closure of NT-3/NT-5 leftover-design is preserved, not reopened — corroborated against live d147StandingCarried since that basedOn entry carries no digest. No finding schema, no Coverage-domain encoding, no D9 code; the only bare integers in the file are 1 and 26. OBL-G23-FX-AUTHORING remains leftover-design with the gate-row owner, undisturbed. All cited digests recomputed clean; HEAD 5d5d778; required-now 26. One observation: the per-D-002-platform axis is not materialised, now the third input corpus in this chain to omit it.
